identifier_invariants.statement: the id never changes across versions, member changes or a direction flip
the id is not a function of the members
ids are never reused after retirement
retrieval accepts the id and only the id
a version names a state, the id names the object

mutation_invariants.statement: a mutation changes only the rows of the composite it names
atoms are immutable, so no member change alters a shared atom
retirement leaves a tombstone and never frees the id
the primitive never writes the frozen V1 graph

collision_rule: copy-on-write at the level of bindings: composites hold versioned references to immutable atoms

earning_test.prediction: members predict held-out edges better than the same atoms' pair counts
earning_test.control: intervening on one composite leaves a bystander composite unchanged
earning_test.decision: an interval including zero means the primitive is bookkeeping and the charter fails

open_questions: what normalisation makes rotated paths collide deterministically
how is the store compacted without changing a resolution
is registration cheap enough to run per detected structure
